attchmntText: Black Box Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Black Box Limited has announced an earnings call for the second quarter and half-year financial results of fiscal year 2027. The call is scheduled for Saturday, November 14, 2026, at 10:00 A.M. IST. Participants include Mr. Sanjeev Verma, Whole Time Director and CEO, Mr. Deepak Bansal, Executive Director and Global CFO, and Mr. Purvesh Parekh, Head of Investor Relations. The company has provided dial-in numbers for local and international access, including toll-free lines for Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK, and the USA. Stakeholders are requested to pre-register via the provided link. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. The announcement was issued by Company Secretary Aditya Goswami on November 9, 2026.

attchmntText: Gland Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Xiao Le as the Chief Investment Officer for Gland Pharma International Pte. Ltd (Wholly- owned subsidiary of Gland Pharma Limited), effective November 09, 2026
voiceSummary: Gland Pharma Limited has appointed Mr. Xiao Le as the Chief Investment Officer of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Gland Pharma International Pte. Ltd, effective November 09, 2026. Mr. Xiao Le will report to the CEO of Gland Singapore and is responsible for exploring investment opportunities and improving M&A capability in the United States of America, China, Singapore, and other countries. He holds over 15 years of experience in investment and asset management within medical devices, biopharma, and healthcare services. His background includes roles as Chief Financial Officer for MegaRobo Technologies, Director at CANbridge Pharmaceuticals, and Senior Director of M&A and Strategic Investments for Wuxi AppTec. Mr. Xiao Le holds a Bachelor’s degree in Bio-engineering from The Johns Hopkins University and a Master’s degree in Finance from The Massachusetts Institute of Technology. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Shyam Metalics And Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 09, 2026, titled "Shyam Metalics Reaffirms Credit Ratings of  CRISIL AA+/Stable  and  CRISIL A1+ ; Bank Debt Ratings Enhanced to ₹4,500 Crore.".
voiceSummary: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited announced that CRISIL Ratings Limited has reaffirmed its long-term credit rating at CRISIL AA plus with a stable outlook and its short-term rating at CRISIL A1 plus. The agency has enhanced the rated bank debt amount to 4500 crore rupees, up from 3600 crore rupees. Additionally, the rating for the company's 50 crore rupee commercial paper programme was reaffirmed at CRISIL A1 plus. The announcement was issued on 09th November 2026.

attchmntText: Precision Wires India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Precision Wires India Limited published its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in the Free Press Journal and Navshakti on November 7, 2026. GTL Infrastructure Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the same period, approved by its Board on November 6, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, GTL Infrastructure recorded total income from operations of 33,514 lakhs and a net profit after tax of 26,291 lakhs, compared to a net loss of 19,347 lakhs in the previous year. Earnings per share were 0.20 rupees for the current quarter versus negative 0.15 rupees previously. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, GTL Infrastructure reported total income of 66,751 lakhs and a net profit after tax of 33,230 lakhs, compared to a net loss of 42,589 lakhs in the prior year. Earnings per share were 0.25 rupees for the half year, compared to negative 0.33 rupees previously.

attchmntText: Morepen Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 09, 2026, titled "Morepen enters U.S. prescription generics market, building on its established API strengths".
voiceSummary: Morepen Laboratories Limited filed a press release on 09/11/2026 announcing the launch of its first prescription generic product, Desloratadine Tablets USP 5 mg, in the U.S. market through its wholly owned arm, Morepen Bio Inc. The company has previously supplied Desloratadine API to the U.S. for many years. Additionally, Morepen submitted its first Abbreviated New Drug Application to the U.S. FDA for Sitagliptin Phosphate Tablets USP in strengths of 25 mg, 50 mg, and 100 mg. This application is currently under regulatory review. The company intends to pursue additional U.S. prescription generic filings and may evaluate opportunities in high potency APIs and oncology subject to feasibility and market conditions.

attchmntText: BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Business Update for the Festive Season'.
voiceSummary: BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Limited filed a provisional business update for the festive season covering October 1, 2026 to November 8, 2026. The company reported a 45% year-on-year business growth for the quarter-to-date period of Q3 FY27. This growth was driven by buyer transactions, with average realizations remaining comparable to the previous year. The performance included the Dhanteras and Diwali festivals. The data is unaudited and subject to audit review.

attchmntText: Neogen Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Neogen Chemicals Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call held on November 2, 2026. Consolidated revenue increased by 42% year-on-year to INR 296 crore, with EBITDA improving by 51% to INR 45 crore. Standalone PAT surged 127% to INR 21 crore. The company completed a Qualified Institutional Placement raising INR 600 crore. Insurance claim recoveries total INR 316 crore, including an accepted additional claim of INR 152 crore. The Board approved expanding Organolithium capacity at Patancheru from 300 to 600 metric tonnes per annum with an outlay of up to INR 45 crore. Neogen Ionics Limited executed a business transfer agreement for lithium-ion electrolyte salt operations to Neogen Morita New Materials Limited for INR 245 crore. CRISIL upgraded the long-term bank facility outlook to stable. Net debt stood at INR 1,095 crore on a consolidated basis as of September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: MphasiS Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 152891  Shares.
voiceSummary: Mphasis Limited intimates that its ESOP Compensation Committee approved the allotment of 1,52,891 equity shares on 8 November 2026. This allotment is against the exercise of Employee Stock Options and Restricted Stock Units. Specifically, 15,500 shares were allotted under the Employee Stock Options Plan 2016. Additionally, 1,37,391 shares were allotted under the Restricted Stock Units Plan 2021. For employees exercising options under the Cashless Scheme, the Mphasis Employees Equity Reward Trust will deduct shares to cover exercise prices and taxes. These proceeds will repay loans from the company. Similarly, the Mphasis Employees Benefit Trust will deduct shares for the RSU Plan 2021 to cover costs and taxes. The terms of exercise follow the respective plans already submitted to stock exchanges.

attchmntText: Mawana Sugars Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter ended on 30" September, 2026
voiceSummary: Mawana Sugars Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 in the Jansatta and Financial Express newspapers on 8 November 2026. Fratelli Vineyards Limited, formerly known as Tinna Trade Limited, released its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 56.73 lakhs for the standalone quarter ended 30 September 2026. The standalone net profit for the period was 12.67 lakhs. Consolidated revenue from operations for the same quarter was 4524.18 lakhs. The consolidated net loss for the quarter was 632.07 lakhs.

attchmntText: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, via its wholly owned subsidiary Jubilant Advanced Electronics Limited, has executed a Share Subscription and Share Purchase Agreement to acquire a 40% strategic equity stake in Zettaone Technologies India Private Limited. The transaction includes an option to increase shareholding to 51% during the next year, subject to terms and conditions. This move allows the company to enter the Electronics Design and Manufacturing Services sector. The investment aims to serve customers in semiconductors, aerospace, defense, and automotive segments. It also supports the company's semiconductor and electronics chemicals vertical by combining manufacturing excellence with new capabilities. Key terms were previously disclosed in a letter dated October 1, 2026. The information is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Auri Grow India Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
voiceSummary: Auri Grow India Limited reports the outcome of the second Committee of Creditors meeting held on 28th October 2026. The Committee approved the reimbursement of expenses for registered valuers, forensic auditors, accountants, and the publication of Form G. The company is undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process admitted by the National Company Law Tribunal on 18th September 2026. An invitation for expression of interest is issued. The last date for receipt of expressions of interest is 13th November 2026. The provisional list of prospective resolution applicants will be issued on 23rd November 2026. The last date for submission of objections is 28th November 2026. The final list of applicants will be issued on 08th December 2026. The information memorandum and request for resolution plans will be issued on 13th December 2026. The last date for submission of resolution plans is 08th January 2027. Revenue for FY 2024-25 was Rs. 17948.89 Lacs and for FY 2025-2026 was Rs. 1379.50 Lacs.

attchmntText: Auri Grow India Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
voiceSummary: Auri Grow India Limited reports the outcome of the first Committee of Creditors meeting held on 17th October 2026, adjourned to 19th October 2026. The company was admitted into the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process by the National Company Law Tribunal Indore Bench on 18th September 2026. The Committee approved the reimbursement of expenses for the public announcement of the insolvency initiation. Other costs directly relating to the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process were also approved for inclusion in the Insolvency Resolution Process costs. The remuneration of the Interim Resolution Professional was approved. A Resolution Professional was appointed, and their fees were finalized. The Committee approved the reduction in the notice period required to call for future Committee of Creditors meetings. Rajesh Jasti, the Resolution Professional, signed the disclosure.

attchmntText: Alkem Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of incorporation of subsidiary in the form of Joint Venture.
voiceSummary: Alkem Laboratories Limited incorporated a subsidiary named Alkem Pharma Company, Limited Liability Company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on 8th November, 2026. This entity operates as a Joint Venture in the pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals industry. The company holds a 51% stake in the subsidiary. The total capital of the new entity is 7,500,000.0 SAR, divided into 75,000.0 shares of 100 SAR each. Alkem Laboratories subscribed to 38,250 shares, amounting to 3,825,000.00 SAR. The investment is a strategic move to expand business and market reach in Saudi Arabia. The subsidiary will handle the manufacture, import, marketing, and distribution of pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products. The transaction is not a related party transaction. No promoter group has an interest in the entity.

attchmntText: Tata Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Tata Chemicals announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Consolidated and Audited Standalone Financial Results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, during a meeting on November 7, 2026. The results were published in newspapers on November 8, 2026. Consolidated revenue from continuing operations was 4,177 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 8,432 crore for the half-year. Consolidated loss after tax was 50 crore for the quarter and 10 crore for the half-year. Standalone revenue from continuing operations was 1,303 crore for the quarter and 2,584 crore for the half-year. Standalone profit after tax was 122 crore for the quarter and 465 crore for the half-year. Consolidated earnings per share were negative 4.79 for the quarter and negative 5.46 for the half-year. Standalone earnings per share were 4.79 for the quarter and 18.25 for the half-year.

attchmntText: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about completion of acquisition of 100% stake in Vizag Mega Data Center Park Limited by AdaniConneX Private Limited ( ACX ), a joint venture of the Company.
voiceSummary: Adani Enterprises Limited confirms the completion of the acquisition of a 100% stake in Vizag Mega Data Center Park Limited by AdaniConneX Private Limited, a joint venture of the Company. This transaction was executed under a share purchase agreement with Adani Infra India Limited, the seller. The completion follows the earlier intimation dated November 6, 2026. With this acquisition, Vizag Mega Data Center Park Limited has become a joint venture of Adani Enterprises Limited. The details of the acquisition were previously furnished pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: The Federal Bank  Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: The Federal Bank Limited has intimated the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited regarding the schedule of an analyst and institutional investor meeting. Representatives of the bank will meet a group of analysts and investors physically on November 11, 2026. This intimation is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The schedule is subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances involving the bank or participating attendees. Any updates or revisions will be promptly communicated to the exchanges. The notice was issued by Samir P Rajdev, Company Secretary, on November 08, 2026.

attchmntText: Autoline Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
